## Description and Rationale

I am a student at Université Paris Cité with a strong interest in data science, machine learning, and aviation. I decided to participate in the PRC Data Challenge to apply my skills to a real-world problem and learn more about air traffic management and predictive modeling

## Details

* Type: Independent
* Country: France
